info.name: auth-service
info.description: Auth Service. Folder start: new customer and admin login (run once per run). Folder direct: the service directly at {{baseUrl}}; run the folders in order (3 logins per run from the address in clientIp). Folder via Gateway: registration and the session from start through {{gatewayUrl}}; it logs the customer of start out, so it runs last.
